title: Add dark mode toggle to reduce eye strain

requirements.summary: Add a dark mode toggle button in the application header that allows users to switch between light and dark color schemes
acceptanceCriteria: A toggle button is visible in the application header
Clicking the toggle switches between light and dark modes
The selected mode persists across page refreshes
The toggle button icon or label clearly indicates the current mode

file_operations.description: Create a custom React hook that manages dark mode state, reads and writes the preference to localStorage, and applies the 'dark' class to the document element. The hook should return the current dark mode state and a toggle function.

Create a toggle button component that uses the useDarkMode hook to display the current mode and allow users to switch between light and dark modes. The button should show appropriate icons or labels indicating the current mode (e.g., sun icon for light mode, moon icon for dark mode).
Import and add the DarkModeToggle component to the application header section, positioning it appropriately near the title 'Daily Todo' so it's visible and accessible to users.

requirements.summary: Implement dark mode styling by applying the 'dark' class to the html or body element and ensuring all components respect the existing dark mode OKLCH color variables defined in index.css
acceptanceCriteria: Dark mode uses the warm earth-toned color palette already defined in the CSS variables
All text remains readable with appropriate contrast in dark mode
Background colors, borders, and shadows adapt to dark mode
The PassiveAggressiveModal dialog styling works correctly in both modes
Task checkboxes, edit buttons, and input fields are properly styled in dark mode

file_operations.description: Ensure the existing dark mode CSS variables are properly scoped under the .dark class selector and verify that all components use these variables correctly. Add any missing dark mode utility classes or adjust existing styles to ensure proper contrast and readability in dark mode.

Review and update component styling to ensure task checkboxes, edit buttons, inline edit controls, and text inputs properly respond to dark mode by using the existing CSS variables. Verify that borders, backgrounds, and hover states work correctly in both light and dark modes.

Review and update the input field and submit button styling to ensure they properly adapt to dark mode using the existing OKLCH color variables, maintaining appropriate contrast and visual feedback in both modes.

Review and update the modal dialog styling to ensure proper rendering in dark mode, including dialog background, text color, borders, and the close button. Verify that the modal content remains readable with appropriate contrast in both light and dark modes.

requirements.summary: Store the user's dark mode preference in localStorage so it persists across browser sessions and is applied immediately on page load
acceptanceCriteria: The dark mode preference is saved to localStorage when toggled
On page load, the saved preference is read and applied before rendering
If no preference exists, default to light mode
No flash of unstyled content occurs when loading in dark mode

file_operations.description: Implement localStorage integration within the useDarkMode hook to save the preference when toggled and read it on initialization. Use a useEffect hook to apply the 'dark' class to the document element based on the saved preference, defaulting to light mode if no preference exists.

Add an inline script in the HTML head that reads the dark mode preference from localStorage and immediately applies the 'dark' class to the html element before React hydration. This prevents any flash of unstyled content when loading the page in dark mode.
